title: Cardboard Chalkbox
description: Datapack that adds a recipe to Chalk mod for use with Create mod
body:
![A item frame showing a cardboard item, a blue arrow pointing from left to right indicating another item frame with the chalk box, on a black background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c81c52591aedb7b06f6502c032e7ff520bac3b62.jpeg) [](https://www.curseforge.com/members/kentapainter/projects)[](https://discord.gg/C47W2vcKX)[]() # Cardboard Chalkbox For those who don't like getting lost in caves, there's the [Chalk](https://modrinth.com/mod/chalk-mod) Mod. And for those who love being engineers, there's the [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) Mod... so since Create 6.0 brought cardboard, why not include its recipe in Chalk? Here's my datapack for this purpose.
## Installation: ### Just place it in your datapack folder.
But for those who don't know how to do it: 1. Go to where you have Minecraft installed. 2. Find the **saves** folder. 3. You'll see folders with the names of your worlds; choose the one you want to use the datapack on. 4. Place the file in the **datapacks** folder. Something like this: C:\User\ .minecraft\saves\new_world\datapacks Just leave it there, done!


This datapack includes the recipe unlock from the Create's cardboard achievement, and it's included in the recipe list of the original Chalk mod. Therefore, you need both for this datapack to work.
